title: TransferV2BreakingResponse
description: Reference fixture only -- NOT loaded by SchemaCompatibilityTest, and never published as a real API version. This documents the shape TransferV2Controller actually emits once the schema-drift defect is active (DefectFlags.isActive("schema-drift")): transferRef renamed to transfer_id, status and settledAt unchanged. SchemaCompatibilityTest#defectFlagRenamesAFieldAndBreaksTheContract deliberately validates that drifted response against the real, still-published transfer-v2.schema.json instead of against this file, precisely to prove the defect breaks the contract clients actually depend on. This file exists purely so a reader can see, side by side with transfer-v2.schema.json, exactly which single field the rename touches -- i.e. what a team would have had to publish as an intentional new version, rather than let leak into v2 as a defect.

transfer_id.description: The schema-drift defect's renamed form of v2's transferRef field. Same UUID value, different key.

status.description: Settlement status of the transfer. Unchanged by the defect.

settledAt.description: Timestamp the transfer settled. Unchanged by the defect.
